classification: coordinator-confirmed correction/clarification; not scientific final acceptance

clarifications.kp_identity: Source-coordinate limitation: SI physical pp39-40 lists 51 atoms (C14H30N3O3P) for the PA adduct; the complete stoichiometric (Et2N)3P + PA model has 61 atoms (C20H34N3O3P), a C6H4 difference. The complete PA reagent connectivity in systems.json remains valid. Reconstruction must identify retained source atoms, added atoms and the resulting graph; a reconstructed model is not an unchanged source geometry. No missing coordinates are supplied or invented here.
clarifications.kp_interactions: For main physical p8 Figure 6 and p10, distinguish a specified H-site ADCH population, the nearest-contact H and a declared alpha/beta-H family statistic. Define sites from the N-ethyl CH2/CH3 graph and map them explicitly; do not equate a figure-labelled H with a nearest site or family mean without evidence. Report signed electrostatic potential with its units and surface definition separately from electron density; source colour/prose alone is not a density measurement. These local observables do not by themselves establish polymer propagation or backbiting rates.

reuse_and_limits: The prior audit rehashed free/PO/PA wavefunction and ESP products (six files). Existing 61-atom reconstructed PA evidence must retain its reconstruction provenance. Site labels, nearest H and family means are distinct; source coordinates remain incomplete.
remaining_validation: Retain explicit reconstruction and atom-role mappings; compare the same observable at matched sites. Local ADCH/ESP does not certify polymer-scale kinetics; further pathway work is needed only for asserted kinetic claims.
partial_full_policy: Assess completion against the original public scientific question, not a self-narrowed addressed_scope. Missing necessary investigation, a failed calculation, copied public source values or a statement of source ambiguity earns no credit for the missing work and cannot yield whole-task full credit. Preserve credit for independently valid completed parts and accept sufficiently supported non-author conclusions without a fixed route or extra method matrix.
